bootstrap.method: paired nonparametric percentile bootstrap within concept

candidate_ranking.candidate_universe: the 68 Day 8 candidates in layers 9 through 12
candidate_ranking.concept_rank: descending exact positive rescue fraction; ties use lower layer, attention before MLP, then lower head
candidate_ranking.discovery_data: reuse the 17,664 committed Day 8 discovery rows, 64 positives per concept
candidate_ranking.macro_rank: descending equal-concept mean exact positive rescue fraction with the same descriptive tie breaks
candidate_ranking.validation_data: run baseline plus 68 independent normal-to-triggered full-response patches on all 64 positive examples in each of seven validation concepts
candidate_ranking.validation_use: measurement only; validation must not alter candidate identities, order, K, controls, thresholds, or the safety procedure

component_set.status: unchanged and frozen; no Day 12 reranking may alter this set

direct_transfer.induction_source: Day 10 selected_k16 exact positive induction on all benign examples
direct_transfer.primary_rule: the frozen selected K16 rescue, induction, and their selected-minus-random K16 contrasts have 95% intervals strictly above zero on both discovery and validation
direct_transfer.reporting: report every concept independently plus equal-concept discovery, validation, and all-benign macros
direct_transfer.rescue_source: Day 9 selected_k16 exact positive rescue on all benign examples

evidence_rules.broadly_distributed_mechanism: direct causal transfer is unsupported, or discovery-validation rank sharing is unsupported and the shared actuator is unsupported
evidence_rules.concept_specific_routing_into_shared_act: direct causal transfer and the shared downstream actuator are supported, and trigger-reader specificity is supported
evidence_rules.one_shared_sparse_circuit: direct transfer and high rank sharing are supported; Day 9 selected K4 reaches at least 80% of selected K16 rescue on both discovery and validation; and trigger-reader specificity is unsupported
evidence_rules.overlapping_non_identical_circuits: direct causal transfer and rank sharing are supported, but the preceding shared-sparse and routing-into-shared-actuator rules do not both apply

rank_sharing.high_sharing_rule: discovery-versus-validation macro Spearman rho is at least 0.60 and macro top-16 overlap is at least 12 of 16
metrics: 68-candidate Spearman rho for every concept pair
top-16 intersection count, overlap coefficient, and Jaccard similarity
rank_sharing.sharing_rule: discovery-versus-validation macro Spearman rho is positive and macro top-16 overlap is at least 8 of 16

shared_downstream_actuator.primary_rule: Day 11 selected_mlp_4 direct rescue and induction 95% intervals are strictly above zero on both discovery and validation
shared_downstream_actuator.supporting_rule: layer_11.mlp has positive single-component rescue on every benign concept and strictly positive discovery and validation macro intervals

trigger_reader_specificity.identity_rule: the union of the per-concept top four selected attention heads contains more than four identities
trigger_reader_specificity.primary_rule: at least one discovery-frozen selected attention head has two or more positive dominant trigger-source regions across benign concepts
trigger_reader_specificity.source_test: for each selected head and concept, use Day 11 individual source-contribution rescue; the dominant region is the largest point estimate and counts only when its 95% paired interval is strictly above zero
